title: Wildbound
description: Tame the untameable — bond vanilla mobs with an amethyst shard. Each companion follows you, wanders on command, parks where you ask, and grants a gentle gift.
body:
Deep in the glittering geodes, the old clerics learned a secret: a shard of amethyst carries a resonance the wild cannot ignore. 

Hold out a **shard** and create your bond. It takes a few tries (smoke means *not yet* -- hearts mean *yours*).

---

🌿 **Wildbound** lets you bind the friendship of eleven of the overworld's souls. Each companion that walks with you - or keeps watch where you bid it stay - lends you a sliver of its gifts.

Bid one **sit** (an empty hand) and it keeps watch - its gift still flowing.

Send it to **wander** (sneak, empty hand) and it lives freely around a home it remembers, until you call on it again. 

A drink of **milk** quiets the flow of the gift, for when an effect is in your way. 

Every command is answered in kind: a puff of colour and the animal's own voice, so you always know what you asked of it.

---

## 🦇 Companions

| Mob | Gift |
|---|---|
| Bat | Night Vision I |
| Rabbit | Jump Boost I |
| Frog | Slow Falling I |
| Bee | Haste I |
| Panda | Regeneration I |
| Armadillo | Resistance I |
| Axolotl | Night Vision I |
| Turtle | Water Breathing I |
| Ocelot | XP ×2 |
| Fox | Fetches dropped items |
| Sheep | Rideable |


**More to answer the call in the future**

---

## 💎 The Bound Cluster

When the road grows long — an elytra flight, an ocean crossing — press an **amethyst cluster** to your companion and it will sleep inside the crystal — name, mood, memories and all — until you set it free against new ground. The cluster shatters on release, the bond does not.

**Guard it well. A crystal lost is a friend lost. An ender chest keeps a bound friend safest.**

---

## 📜 For the chroniclers

A full advancement tree marks your path, from the first shard you pocket to the day the wild knows your name — when one of every kind has chosen to walk with you.

---

### Notes:
- Install on **server and client**
- Per-animal config — enable each companion, taming odds, effect level, wander radius (`config/wildbound.json`).
